nodes.label: Confidence Tier System (AUTO_APPLY/REVIEW/EXCEPTION)
nodes.rationale: Cash application uses deterministic rules, never an LLM, because a wrong automatic match moves real money to the wrong ledger.

nodes.label: Collections Hard Guards
nodes.rationale: Guards enforced structurally (content-hash dedupe, escalation gating, terminal-state rejection, action caps) rather than via prompt instructions so the FSM can refuse invalid actions deterministically.

nodes.label: Anti-Loop Safeguards
nodes.rationale: Max 6 agent calls per conversation and duplicate-input blocking prevent LLM agents from looping or acting twice on identical input.

nodes.label: Mocked External Integration Pattern (CRM, credit bureau, bank feed)
nodes.rationale: External integrations are mocked behind thin API classes designed to be swapped for real ones, so the FSM and matching logic don't know the difference.
nodes.norm_label: mocked external integration pattern (crm, credit bureau, bank feed)
